comment:
* State machine which maintains the binding to the EuiccService implementation and issues commands. * *

Keeps track of the highest-priority EuiccService implementation to use. When a command comes * in, brings up a binding to that service, issues the command, and lingers the binding as long as * more commands are coming in. The binding is dropped after an idle timeout.

variables.name: BIND_TIMEOUT_MILLIS
variables.comment:
* Maximum amount of time to wait for a connection to be established after bindService returns
     * true or onServiceDisconnected is called (and no package change has occurred which should
     * force us to reestablish the binding).

variables.name: LINGER_TIMEOUT_MILLIS
variables.comment:
* Maximum amount of idle time to hold the binding while in {@link ConnectedState}. After this,
     * the binding is dropped to free up memory as the EuiccService is not expected to be used
     * frequently as part of ongoing device operation.

variables.name: CMD_PACKAGE_CHANGE
variables.comment:
* Command indicating that a package change has occurred. * *

{@link Message#obj} is an optional package name. If set, this package has changed in a * way that will permanently sever any open bindings, and if we're bound to it, the binding must * be forcefully reestablished.

variables.name: CMD_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: Command indicating that {@link #BIND_TIMEOUT_MILLIS} has been reached.

variables.name: CMD_LINGER_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: Command indicating that {@link #LINGER_TIMEOUT_MILLIS} has been reached.

variables.name: CMD_SERVICE_CONNECTED
variables.comment:
* Command indicating that the service has connected. * *

{@link Message#obj} is the connected {@link IEuiccService} implementation.

variables.name: CMD_SERVICE_DISCONNECTED
variables.comment: Command indicating that the service has disconnected.

variables.name: CMD_COMMAND_COMPLETE
variables.comment:
* Command indicating that a command has completed and the callback should be executed. * *

{@link Message#obj} is a {@link Runnable} which will trigger the callback.

variables.name: CMD_GET_EID
variables.comment: Commands corresponding with EuiccService APIs. Keep isEuiccCommand in sync with any changes.

variables.name: EUICC_QUERY_FLAGS
variables.comment: Flags to use when querying PackageManager for Euicc component implementations.

variables.name: mSelectedComponent
variables.comment: Set to the current component we should bind to except in {@link UnavailableState}.

variables.name: mEuiccService
variables.comment: Set to the currently connected EuiccService implementation in {@link ConnectedState}.

variables.name: mActiveCommandCallbacks
variables.comment: The callbacks for all (asynchronous) commands which are currently in flight.
